Assumptions and Limitations                                                 假設及限制

This scenario analysis was carried out during the reporting period. Based   此情景分析於報告期間內進行。根據該等情
on the qualitative findings of these scenarios, the Groups’ software-       景的定性分析結果，本集團以軟件為核心的
centric strategy is considered resilient. Our asset-light model and         策略被視為具有韌性。我們的輕資產模式及
established remote-work capabilities allow for high adaptability to both    已建立的遙距辦公能力，使我們能夠高度適
transition and physical disruptions.                                        應轉型及實體風險所帶來的干擾。

In assessing the Group’s climate resilience as of the reporting date, we    於評估本集團截至報告日期的氣候韌性時，
considered international and local regulatory developments, industry        我們考慮了國際及本地的監管發展、行業最
best practices, and the latest climate science. Notwithstanding the         佳實踐以及最新的氣候科學。儘管有上述規
above, the scenario analysis does not capture all possible climate-         定，情景分析並未能涵蓋所有可能的氣候相
related risks and opportunities. The assessment is subject to inherent      關風險及機遇。該評估受固有不確定因素影
uncertainties, including evolving climate-related policies and              響，包括不斷變化的氣候相關政策及法規、

The production of PCW paper typically requires less energy compared                   與原生紙相比，生產消費後廢紙一般需要較
to virgin paper, as it bypasses the pulping and bleaching processes                   少的能源，因為其繞過與原生纖維生產相關
associated with virgin fibre production. This results in lower greenhouse             的製漿及漂白過程，從而減少溫室氣體排放
gas emissions and reduced energy consumption, contributing                            及能源消耗，對我們致力於環境可持續發展
significantly to our commitment to environmental sustainability.                      的承諾作出重大貢獻。

RESTRICTED SHARE AWARD SCHEME                                             有限制股份獎勵計劃

The Company adopted a restricted share award scheme (the “Award           本公司於二零零八年五月二十二日採納有限
Scheme”) on 22 May 2008 and renewed the Award Scheme on 31 May            制股份獎勵計劃（「獎勵計劃」）及於二零一七
2017 (the “Renewed Date”).                                                年五月三十一日（「重續日期」）重續該獎勵計
                                                                          劃。

The purpose of the Award Scheme is to recognise and motivate the          獎勵計劃旨在嘉許若干僱員之貢獻及鼓勵彼
contributions of certain employees and to provide incentives and help     等作出貢獻，並提供獎勵及協助本集團留聘
the Group in retaining its existing employees and recruiting additional   其現有僱員及增聘更多僱員，並就達致本公
employees and to provide them with a direct economic interest in          司之長遠業務目標向彼等提供直接經濟利
attaining the long-term business objectives of the Company.               益。

Pursuant to the Award Scheme, shares of the Company (the “Awarded         根據獎勵計劃，本公司股份（「獎勵股份」）
Shares”) are granted to eligible employees (i.e. any employee (whether    自重續日期起至十週年止授予本集團任何成
full-time or part-time, including without limitation any executive        員公司的合資格僱員（即任何成員公司的任
director, non-executive director and independent non-executive            何僱員（不論全職或兼職，包括但不限於任
director of any member) of any member of the Group until the 10 th        何執行董事、非執行董事及獨立非執行董
anniversary from the Renewed Date.                                        事））。

          Business combinations and goodwill                                       業務合併及商譽

          Business combinations are accounted for using the acquisition            業務合併乃以收購法入賬。所轉讓代價
          method. The consideration transferred is measured at the                 乃以收購日期之公平值計量，該公平值
          acquisition date fair value which is the sum of the acquisition date     為本集團轉讓之資產、本集團對被收購
          fair values of assets transferred by the Group, liabilities assumed      方前擁有人承擔之負債及本集團為換取
          by the Group to the former owners of the acquiree and the equity         被收購方控制權所發行股本權益於收購
          interests issued by the Group in exchange for control of the             日期之公平值之總和。於各業務合併
          acquiree. For each business combination, the Group elects whether        中，本集團選擇按公平值或按分佔被收
          to measure the non-controlling interests in the acquiree at fair         購方可識別資產淨值之比例，計量被收
          value or at the proportionate share of the acquiree’s identifiable       購方之非控制性權益。所有其他非控制
          net assets. All other components of non-controlling interests are        性權益部分乃按公平值計量。收購相關
          measured at fair value. Acquisition-related costs are expensed as        成本於產生時支銷。
          incurred.

          The Group determines that it has acquired a business when                當本集團收購的一組活動及資產包括一
          the acquired set of activities and assets includes an input and a        項投入及一項實質流程，而兩者會共同
          substantive process that together significantly contribute to the        對創造產出的能力有重大增益，則確定
          ability to create outputs.                                               已收購一項業務。

          When the Group acquires a business, it assesses the financial            當本集團收購一項業務時，會根據合約
          assets and liabilities assumed for appropriate classification and        條款、於收購日期之經濟環境及相關狀
          designation in accordance with the contractual terms, economic           況，評估將承接之財務資產及負債，以
          circumstances and pertinent conditions as at the acquisition date.       作出適合之分類及標示，包括分開被收
          This includes the separation of embedded derivatives in host             購方所訂主合約中之內含衍生工具。
          contracts of the acquiree.

          Fair value measurement                                                      公平值計量

          The Group measures its investment properties, debt investment               本集團於各報告期間結算日按公平值計
          and equity investments at fair value at the end of each reporting           量其投資物業、債務投資及股本投資。
          period. Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset     公平值指市場參與者於計量日期於有秩
          or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between           序交易中因出售資產而收取或轉讓負債
          market participants at the measurement date. The fair value                 而支付之價格。公平值計量乃根據出售
          measurement is based on the presumption that the transaction                資產或轉讓負債之交易於該資產或負債
          to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either in the       之主要市場或（如無主要市場）對該資
          principal market for the asset or liability, or in the absence of a         產或負債為最有利之市場進行之假設進
          principal market, in the most advantageous market for the asset             行。主要或最有利之市場須為本集團可
          and liability. The principal or the most advantageous market must           接達者。資產及負債之公平值乃採用市
          be accessible by the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability       場參與者在替該資產或負債進行定價時
          is measured using the assumptions that market participants would            將會採用之假設而計量，當中假設市場
          use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market               參與者乃按其最佳經濟利益而行事。
          participants act in their economic best interest.

          A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into                非財務資產之公平值計量考慮市場參與
          account a market participant’s ability to generate economic                 者透過以最高及最佳用途使用該資產或
          benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by selling       透過將其出售予將以最高及最佳用途使
          it to another market participant that would use the asset in its            用該資產之另一市場參與者而賺取經濟
          highest and best use.                                                       利益之能力。

          The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in                 本集團採用於各情況均屬合適及可取得
          the circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to            足夠數據以計量公平值之估值技巧，從
          measure fair value, maximising the use of relevant observable               而將相關可觀察輸入數據之用途盡量擴
          inputs and minimising the use of unobservable inputs.                       大及將不可觀察輸入數據之用途盡量減
                                                                                      少。

          Leases – Estimating the incremental borrowing rate                        租賃－估算增量借款利率

          The Group cannot readily determine the interest rate implicit in a         本集團無法輕易釐定租賃內所隱含的利
          lease, and therefore, it uses an incremental borrowing rate (“IBR”)        率，因此，本集團使用增量借款利率
          to measure lease liabilities. The IBR is the rate of interest that the    （「增量借款利率」）計量租賃負債。增量
          Group would have to pay to borrow over a similar term, and with a          借款利率為本集團於類似經濟環境中為
          similar security, the funds necessary to obtain an asset of a similar      取得與使用權資產價值相近之資產，而
          value to the right-of-use asset in a similar economic environment.         以類似抵押品與類似期間借入所需資金
          The IBR therefore reflects what the Group “would have to                   應支付之利率。因此，增量借款利率反
          pay”, which requires estimation when no observable rates are               映了本集團「應支付」的利率，當無可觀
          available (such as for subsidiaries that do not enter into financing       察的利率時（如就並無訂立融資交易之
          transactions) or when it needs to be adjusted to reflect the terms         附屬公司而言）或當須對利率進行調整
          and conditions of the lease. The Group estimates the IBR using             以反映租賃之條款及條件時，則須作出
          observable inputs (such as market interest rates) when available.          利率估計。當可觀察輸入數據可用時，
                                                                                     本集團使用可觀察輸入數據（如市場利
                                                                                     率）估算增量借款利率。

36. EVENTS AFTER THE REPORTING PERIOD                                       36. 報告期後之事項

   Following the end of the reporting period, in March 2026, the              於報告期間結算日後，本集團於二零
   Group received a formal termination notice from the landlord in            二六年三月就其於香港的現有總部辦公
   respect of its existing head office in Hong Kong. Together with the        室接獲業主發出的正式終止租約通知。
   termination notice, the landlord and the incoming property owner           隨同該終止通知，業主及接手業主亦向

   out indicative terms for the early termination of the tenancy.             列提前終止租賃的指示性條款。

   Group is in the process of reviewing the termination notice and            該終止通知進行審閱，並評估建議交回
   assessing the detailed terms of the proposed surrender agreement.          租約協議的具體條款。相關租賃或可根
   The tenancy may be terminated in accordance with the relevant              據現有租約的相關條文及建議的交回租
   provisions of the existing tenancy agreement and the proposed              約安排予以終止。
   surrender arrangement.

   The termination notice was issued after the reporting period and           該終止通知於報告期後發出，並涉及於
   relates to circumstances that did not exist at 31 December 2025.           二零二五年十二月三十一日並不存在的
   Accordingly, the event represents a non adjusting event after the          情況。因此，該事項構成報告期後的
   reporting period. Given that discussions with the landlord and the         非調整事項。鑑於預期仍需與業主及接

   to the proposed surrender arrangement have been agreed, the                排的最終條款尚未確定，本公司董事認
   directors of the Company are of the opinion that it is not possible        為，於批准此等財務報表當日，尚未能
   to reliably estimate the financial effect of this event at the date of     可靠地估計該事項可能帶來的財務影
